HKU campus digital survey — original procedural sound assets, 2026-11-14.
The original top-level WAV files listed below were synthesized by scripts/generate-audio.py,
using only seeded noise, sinusoidal tones and envelopes. No external recording,
voice, sample pack, music or paid service is used.
To the extent possible under law, the authors dedicate these WAV assets and the
synthesis script to the public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Source/version: this project's scripts/generate-audio.py, v9 (seed 904).
Footsteps: step-paving.wav / step-grass.wav; environment: wind-leaves.wav;
UI: select, equip, bag, collect, complete, view.

Added campus/ and kenney/ assets are third-party CC0 recordings/sample packs.
Their attribution, licenses and processing are documented in SOURCES.md and kenney/License.txt.
The old top-level synthetic footsteps/wind are retained for historical comparison; runtime uses campus/.
